about: Classes for tools/solver/scan_utility_gains.py's sites (FIGHT_SOLVER.md section 19), each with why. gain: raises the utility within a combat; its holders turn the tight bound off while present. generator: makes cards or potions from a pool not proved free of a gain holder. fixed: makes the named cards (makes), none a gain holder. copy-card: copies a card the combat holds. end: the combat's end, with the most it heals (constant) and whether the winning step applies it before the terminal is scored (applied). loss, primitive (a helper's own body), copy, setup, run, other (another creature) and safe. files: the files outside the scan that name a needle.

RunRewardGenerator:GenerateCombatRewards.why: Burning Blood heals 6 after a won combat. GenerateCombatRewards runs on the RunState after the combat: the solver steps a combat on its own and its end is the step's terminal result (KernelGate.BareHost.EndCombat), so the terminal is scored before this heal

Black Blood heals 12 after a won combat. GenerateCombatRewards runs on the RunState after the combat: the solver steps a combat on its own and its end is the step's terminal result (KernelGate.BareHost.EndCombat), so the terminal is scored before this heal

Meat on the Bone heals 12 after a won combat at or below half HP. GenerateCombatRewards runs on the RunState after the combat: the solver steps a combat on its own and its end is the step's terminal result (KernelGate.BareHost.EndCombat), so the terminal is scored before this heal

Chosen Cheese: max HP +1 and a heal of 1 after the combat. GenerateCombatRewards runs on the RunState after the combat: the solver steps a combat on its own and its end is the step's terminal result (KernelGate.BareHost.EndCombat), so the terminal is scored before this heal
